name: @hasna/consolidations
description: Group financial consolidation: ingest entity GL data, normalize charts of accounts, translate multi-currency, run intercompany eliminations, produce consolidated P&L/BS/CF — CLI + MCP + serve over a Hasna-contract store.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli/index.tsx --outdir dist/cli --external zod --target bun --external ink --external react --external chalk --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external hono --external pg && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --external zod --target bun --external @modelcontextprotocol/sdk --external pg && bun build src/server/index.ts --outdir dist/server --external zod --target bun --external hono --external pg && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --external zod --target bun --external pg && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run conformance
scripts.openapi:generate: bun run src/cli/index.tsx openapi generate --out openapi.json
scripts.openapi:check: bun run src/cli/index.tsx openapi check --path openapi.json
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run scan-artifact

author: Andrei Hasna <andrei@hasna.com>
